pages.title: How to Warp
pages.text: The Control Seat provides convenient warp travel. Record a position, then warp back to it from another location in the same dimension.$(br2)1. Obtain enough E-710 fuel. Arthropods killed while standing on a subspace—not merely in the world—can drop Concentrated Solid E-710. Processing one piece through Create's draining system produces 1000 mB of E-710 fuel.

2. Put E-710 into a fuel tank linked to the Control Seat. A fuel tank can hold only one fluid, so E-710 and ordinary propulsion fuel must use separate tanks.$(br2)3. Travel to the desired destination and Shift-right-click with a Warp Position Chip to record the current position.$(br2)4. Shift-right-click the Control Seat with an empty hand to open its inventory. This inventory accepts only Warp Position Chips that already contain coordinates.

5. While seated, press the warp key—P by default—to open the warp screen and select one of the stored Warp Position Chips.$(br2)6. After selecting a destination, warp preparation begins. The approximate E-710 cost is subspace mass (kpg) * warp distance (m) / 10 mB, rounded up. Warp cannot begin if linked tanks contain too little E-710.$(br2)7. Wait for the subspace to align itself with the warp direction and complete the jump. Pointing the Control Seat toward the destination beforehand reduces alignment time.$(br2)Most blocks have a mass of 1 kpg. Wear Pilot Goggles to view the mass of block items in your inventory.
